title: Small-Bench NLP: Benchmark for small single GPU trained models in Natural Language Processing
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on creating a benchmark for computationally efficient language models. While it mentions the financial and environmental costs (carbon footprint) of large models as motivation, it does not evaluate or benchmark morals, ethics, or faith-related aspects. The proposed benchmark uses standard NLP tasks from GLUE, which are not designed to measure these dimensions.
